title: KODEX — KPATH: operational
description:
KODEX — KPATH (operational). operational controller surrogate — (state, setpoint) -> command; imitation of the MPC over the closed-loop control traces

Benchmark: MPC-imitation controller R²=0.879 over 6 axes
